mapper.sql: id, instance_id, cmd_seq, raw_cmd_content, translated_cmd_content, result_tips, single_cmd_status, start_time, end_time, tenant, deleted, create_by, creator_id, creator_type, create_time, update_by, updater_id, updater_type, update_time, device_id
mapper.select: SELECT cr.instance_id AS instanceId, cr.raw_cmd_content AS rawCmdContent, cr.result_tips AS resultTips, cr.single_cmd_status AS status FROM iot_command_record cr INNER JOIN iot_command_info ci ON cr.cmd_seq = ci.cmd_seq WHERE ci.down_cmd = #{downCmd} AND cr.deleted = 0 AND ci.deleted = 0 AND cr.instance_id = #{instanceId} LIMIT 1
SELECT log_content AS logContent, create_time AS createTime FROM iot_command_log WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time ASC
